name: Topology Simplification via Volumetric Modification
aliases: Topology Simplification via Volumetric Modification — Genus Reduction, Handle Removal
definition: The method removes extraneous topological handles from isosurfaces extracted from volumetric data (e.g., CT, MRI) by modifying the scalar volume values rather than performing mesh surgery, ensuring the resulting isosurface remains a manifold.
summary: Topology Simplification via Volumetric Modification removes extraneous topological handles from volumetric data by modifying scalar values rather than performing mesh surgery, ensuring the resulting isosurface remains a manifold.
